alert_news.title: India’s First U23 Greco‑Roman Silver Medal Won by Vishvajit More
bullets: Vishvajit More secured India’s first U23 Greco‑Roman silver medal at the World Wrestling Championships in Las Vegas, 2026.
First Indian wrestler to win a Greco‑Roman silver at the U23 level.
Medal contributed to India’s first medal at the 2026 U23 Championships.

alert_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Rs 3350 Crore Development Projects in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first airport terminal equipped with geothermal heating and solar power systems at Leh Airport, costing ₹650 crore and expanding annual passenger capacity from 10 lakh to 35 lakh
India’s first dedicated Petroglyph Conservation Park inaugurated in Leh to protect prehistoric rock art

alert_news.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train: 371 Km Of Viaduct Completed, Over 9,300 OHE Masts Installed
bullets: India’s first bullet train corridor – the 508‑km Mumbai–Ahmedabad high‑speed rail – being built by NHSRCL, expected to be operational by 2029
371 km of viaduct and 9,300 overhead equipment masts installed, marking significant progress toward the 320‑kmph operational speed

alert_news.title: ARAI becomes India's first test agency to offer integrated vehicle cybersecurity services
bullets: India’s first test agency to provide integrated vehicle cybersecurity testing, verification, validation, R&D and homologation under one roof at ARAI
Facility supports compliance with AIS‑189 (Cyber Security Management Systems) and AIS‑190 (Software Update Management Systems), and offers VAPT, TARA, HSM, SSM, and CVE tracking

alert_news.title: India’s First Petroglyph Conservation Park Launched in Ladakh
bullets: India’s first petroglyph conservation park established in Ladakh as part of the ₹3,350 crore development projects launched by PM Modi
The park preserves ancient rock art and cultural heritage of the region

alert_news.title: IBM to install India's first quantum computer in Amaravati in early 2027
bullets: India’s first quantum computer will be installed at the Andhra Pradesh Quantum Valley tech park in Amaravati by IBM.
It will be the largest quantum computer in India, operational early 2027, aimed at post‑quantum cryptography and practical applications.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV-3)
bullets: India’s first indigenous satellite launch vehicle, SLV-3, developed by ISRO, successfully launched the Rohini satellite into Earth orbit on 20 July 1980.
SLV-3 was a four‑stage solid‑fuel rocket with a payload capacity of 100 kg, marking India’s entry into independent space launch capability.
The project, led by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, laid the foundation for subsequent Indian launch vehicles such as PSLV and GSLV.

alert_news.title: Andhra Pradesh's Visakhapatnam ITI cluster becomes India's first to win PM-SETU approval
bullets: India’s first ITI cluster to receive PM‑SETU approval, located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, sanctioned by the PM‑SETU National Steering Committee
Rs 200 crore investment to upgrade four government ITIs, with AM/NS India holding 51% stake and the state and central governments 24.5% each

alert_news.title: Vizag ITI cluster becomes first in India to secure PM-SETU approval
bullets: First ITI cluster in India to receive approval under the Centre’s PM‑SETU scheme, located in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
Four government ITIs upgraded with a ₹200 crore investment from AM/NS India, with a Special Purpose Vehicle; PM‑SETU National Steering Committee cleared the cluster’s Strategic Investment Plan.
Initiative modernises training infrastructure, introduces workplace‑relevant courses, and strengthens employability of Andhra Pradesh youth.
